en: I've been waiting for you.
What's going on?
Since I've also been summoned here,{SAUT}I wished to aid you all in some way...{PAGE}And what came to mind is "Persona{SAUT}sacrificing"―it's a means of{SAUT}strengthening your Personas.
Strengthening?{OPTION}Sacrificing?
You can strengthen our Personas?
Yes. By merging Personas together,{SAUT}your Persona will be able to grow.
That has a rather ominous ring to it.
*chuckle* I won't ask you to offer one{SAUT}of your own as a sacrifice or anything,{SAUT}so please take solace in that.{PAGE}This involves merging Personas together{SAUT}to strengthen your Persona.
Is that different from Persona fusion?

Persona fusion is the means of creating{SAUT}a new Persona from multiple Personas.{PAGE}A sacrifice is performed on a single{SAUT}Persona, wherein other Personas are{SAUT}merged with it to assist in its growth.{PAGE}The original Persona will grow, and{SAUT}those merged will disappear.
One becomes stronger, while the others{SAUT}are lost... That would definitely be{SAUT}considered a sacrifice.
Can that be done with both Main and{SAUT}Sub-Personas?
Yes. It's possible to help both of them{SAUT}grow...{PAGE}Although, naturally, you will be unable{SAUT}to sacrifice your main Persona.
But wait―isn't there more? Like, at a{SAUT}really high cost?

Of course, I will ask for compensation―{SAUT}a reasonable amount. However, since{SAUT}this is for my own research as well...{PAGE}If the Persona to disappear is being{SAUT}sacrificed for the first time, it shall be{SAUT}free of charge.{PAGE}When that Persona is sacrificed again,{SAUT}though, I will ask to be compensated.
So, essentially, all Personas can be{SAUT}sacrificed for free the first time?
That is correct.
Ooh... This is an awesome way for us{SAUT}to grow stronger!
Thanks, Margaret. I appreciate your{SAUT}cooperation.

...No, my part here is destiny's doing{SAUT}as well.{PAGE}With your coming, a change has{SAUT}occurred within the movies―the{SAUT}distorted programs are being corrected.{PAGE}You all may have been cast into roles{SAUT}as Persona-users to accomplish this.
We were cast into such roles?
Yes, and I believe we were called here{SAUT}to watch over this... So, Marie?
Ugh... Do I really have to?
You'll have plenty of time to write your{SAUT}poems, so don't concern yourself with{SAUT}that.
Th-That's not―They're not just my{SAUT}poems, they're my pathos!{PAGE}StupidterribleMargaretyou'retheworst!{SAUT}Just drop it, alright!?
